description:
Homes that are NOT advertised for sale, by criteria: the homes a buyer could write
to. "Which houses on this street could I write to", "owner-occupied houses over
120 m2 in BS7 that last sold before 2005". Filter by property type, floor area,
freehold or leasehold, energy rating, when and for how much the home last sold, and
whether the owner lives there. Each row has the address, type, floor area, energy
rating, last sale and its price per square metre, whether it is owner-occupied, its
response likelihood, and `contact_owner_url`, the link that opens a letter to that
home's owner on GetMovely. 20 a page.

area.description: Where to look: a postcode district ('BS7'), a full postcode ('SW19 1AB'), a town ('Wimbledon'), or a street with its district or town ('Elm Road, BS7'). A town of more than four postcode districts must be narrowed to a district.
area.title: Area

epc_ratings.description: Energy ratings to keep, for example ['E','F','G'] for homes that need work.
epc_ratings.title: Epc Ratings

last_sold_after_year.description: Last sold in or after this year.
last_sold_after_year.title: Last Sold After Year

last_sold_before_year.description: Last sold before this year: long-held homes. Homes with no recorded sale since 1995 are included too unless no_recorded_sale says otherwise.
last_sold_before_year.title: Last Sold Before Year

no_recorded_sale.description: Homes with no sale on record since 1995 (held longest of all): 'only' those, or 'exclude' them.
no_recorded_sale.title: No Recorded Sale

owner_occupied.description: True: only homes whose Energy Performance Certificate records them as owner-occupied (response likelihood Medium), where a letter reaches the owner.
owner_occupied.title: Owner Occupied

property_type.description: From the home's Energy Performance Certificate, which does not say detached, semi-detached or terraced.
property_type.title: Property Type

sort.description: 'owner_occupied_first' (default, the website's order), 'longest_held' oldest last sale first, 'recent' newest sale first, by last sale price, or largest floor area first.
sort.title: Sort

tenure.description: As recorded at the home's last sale, so homes with no recorded sale are left out.
tenure.title: Tenure

name: find_homes_not_for_sale
title: Find homes that are not for sale
